refuted_claims: USGS LOD 16 = 2.389 m/px is a Web Mercator value: about 1.63 m ground at downtown Missoula (1.67 m at Billings).
'470 outlines sit on the roof outlines' fails: median per-building offset 2.5-4.0 m; only 8-36% of footprints peak within 1 m.
MSL public-domain sentence does not cover the NAIP 2025 provisional service by itself (GIS Data List items are 'published by other institutions').
Laplacian variance 390.1 (Missoula 2025 export) is not reproduced: 411.3 to 415.4 depending on convention.
corrections: NAIP 2025 0.3 m: MSL page says 'collected at a spatial resolution of 30 centimeters' (raw). Service pixelSizeX 0.2999999998 is in EPSG:3857 units: 0.205 m ground at 46.87N if Web Mercator metres; unit convention unresolved.
USGS z17-z19 404 at Missoula AND Billings: service maxScale 1:9,028 = LOD 16, so these levels are outside the cache, not local gaps.
USGS NAIP: '0.6 meter' standard is stated for 2018 only (raw); 0.3 m is a coastal option. Base-map text says NAIP is '1-meter pixel resolution' (unexplained conflict).
MSL terms quote incomplete: GIS Data List is 'published by other institutions'; permission from the publisher. NAIP status rests on USGS 'Public Domain'.

Spectral '1.43-1.88x' is band 1.25-1.67 c/ground-m (reproduced 1.41x). Over 0.833-1.667: 3.16x Missoula files, 18.2x Billings (ground-correct). Stronger than 'weak'; compression or sharpening can add power.
Overture 1 km box: 464 of 470 centroids inside (planar), not 462. Missoula pull reproduces: 470 features, 392,140 bytes, 280 height, 58 num_floors.
Microsoft partitions are GeoJSON Lines despite .csv.gz names. Missoula box: 356 centroids (359 intersect), heights 1.0-20.1 m (reproduced).
Missoula city (TIGER 3050200) is 17 polygons with 64 rings incl. holes and 4,324 vertices, not one 64-ring MultiPolygon. TIGER vs OSM city IoU 0.968.
MSL changes page: the previous GIS web services environment (not one host) was retired 2026-07-31. The 2023 NAIP service includes provisional 2024 imagery.
Missoula County: 1955/1964/1972 are MapServers; Flood_1997 pixelSizeX 0.6096 is in 3857 units (0.417 m ground if mercator).
confirmed: MSL ImageServer metadata re-fetched: 2025 0.2999999998; 2023, 2021, 2019 0.6; 4 bands U8; EPSG:3857; DOQQ 1.0 (1 band); Historic 1.0; Reference100k 9.68.
MSL orthoimagery (raw): 2025 provisional service is 'a placeholder until the 2025 NAIP tiffs are made available by the NRCS'.
Missoula 2025 512 px export: 94,860 colours, no pure white or black, 0.977 m/px ground (bbox uses 1/cos(lat)); visibly aerial (viewed).
USGS base-map: NAIP 'majority source' text; ACAO '*'; z16 tiles at Missoula and Billings are real imagery (decoded).
Overture 2026-09-23.1 (raw); 512 building files 276,863,520,053 bytes (276.86 GB decimal); 3 building_part 0.62 GB; 'License for theme: ODbL'.
Microsoft README (raw): CDLA Permissive 2.0, '999M building footprint polygon geometries', no ODbL mention. Overture: 'Licensed by Microsoft under the Open Database License' (conflict confirmed).
unverified: OSM counts (459 ways, 5 relations, 57/8/0 tags) and per-building tags: Overpass reset on 4 of 4 review attempts (6 of 6 before); kumi mirror HTTP 500.
City of Missoula ArcGIS hosts: proxy 502 at CONNECT (03:09:49Z); one probe, not retried; City services and imagery unverified.
USDA 2025 Montana NAIP specification: not retrieved (FSA page redirects; WebSearch found none).
Native ground resolution of the 2025 source: state says 30 cm; service unit convention open; spectra and alignment fit finer detail but do not prove it.
Licence of MSL's NAIP 2025 service on MSL's own terms; NearMap 2026 licence (no licence text on county page).
Billings 2025 vs 2023 alignment peaks differ by about 4 m (2025 +3 m east, +1 m north; 2023 1 m west); cause unknown.
